info.title: AgentCompose Agent API
info.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 methods every AgentCompose-compliant agent exposes. See spec/specification.md and spec/transport.md for normative detail.

methods.name: agent/describe
methods.summary: Return this agent's descriptor (metadata + capabilities). Primary discovery mechanism for the stdio binding; OPTIONAL under HTTP (well-known URL is primary).

methods.name: agent/configure
methods.summary: Supply configuration for a configured instance. The agent MUST validate against its advertised configSchema and return the effective configuration (secret values redacted), or -32007 InvalidConfiguration. SHOULD be called before the first tasks/submit.

methods.name: tasks/submit
methods.summary: Submit a goal and create a new task.

methods.name: tasks/get
methods.summary: Fetch the current state of a task.

methods.name: tasks/cancel
methods.summary: Request graceful cancellation of a task.

methods.name: tasks/provideInput
methods.summary: Supply requested input to a task in the input-required state, resuming it.

methods.name: tasks/subscribe
methods.summary: Subscribe to a task's event stream. The HTTP response is text/event-stream (SSE); the JSON-RPC result is the current Task snapshot, followed by streamed event notifications. See spec/transport.md.
